claims.assertion: Mari describes Urmah as large felines with complex hands and hips adapted for upright walking, while retaining the ability to run and fight on four legs.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Arishah says Urmah value directness, self-respect, loyalty, and honor; they first secure personal stability, then help others without self-harm.
claims.speaker: Arishah
claims.qualifiers: Interview translated and narrated by Mari.

claims.assertion: Arishah says Urmah do not fear death, recall many past lives, and expect to be reborn to fight again.
claims.speaker: Arishah
claims.qualifiers: Interview translated and narrated by Mari.
